title: Siemens AG and Alstom S.A. propose to combine Siemen's mobility business with Alstom

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former provisional decision date of 12 July 2018 delayed until 16 August 2018 to allow the ACCC time to consider additional information.

The merger parties requested that the ACCC delay the timeline to allow them to provide further information. The former provisional decision date of 16 August 2018 was suspended pending receipt of the further information.
The ACCC received further information from the parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties in response to Statement of Issues.
Former provisional decision date of 29 November 2018 delayed, pending receipt of further information from merger parties and market participants.
Information from merger parties referred to on 16 November 2018 received.  New provisional decision date set for 31 January 2019.
Timeline suspended further pending receipt of further information from the merger parties.  Former proposed decision date of 31 January 2019 delayed.
European Commission prohibited the proposed acquisition.
ACCC announced that it would discontinue its public review.

body_sections.Summary: Siemens and Alstom proposed to combine Siemens' mobility business with Alstom. In Australia, Siemens carries on business through its wholly owned subsidiary Siemens Ltd; and Alstom carries on business through its wholly-owned subsidiary Alstom Transport Australia Pty Limited.
